Title: Sr. AI Engineer
Location: San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo León, Mexico
Description: Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward. Role Overview As a Sr. AI Engineer, you will work on more complex AI and analytics initiatives that require strong technical depth, business understanding, and disciplined execution. You will help identify trends in large data sets, develop reusable solutions, and move ideas from analysis into real-world application. The role is focused on delivering value through Palantir-based data work, advanced modeling, and clear collaboration with Finance and Lead Gen stakeholders. What will you do? Partner with Finance and Lead Gen stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into AI and analytics solutions. Work on all stages of complex projects across data modeling, data mining, pattern analysis, data visualization, and analytical interpretation. Build and refine Palantir-based workflows that support data integration, analysis, and insight generation. Apply machine learning and other artificial intelligence techniques to develop practical solutions for business use cases. Research and apply existing and emerging data science principles to improve solution quality and business relevance. Implement analytical solutions into products and service offerings so insights can be operationalized at scale. Collaborate with technical and business partners to validate results, improve data quality, and support adoption. Document assumptions, model logic, and implementation details to support maintainability and reuse. How will you do it? Own the outcome by taking accountability for the quality, reliability, and impact of the solutions you deliver. Stay close to the business problem by working directly with Finance and Lead Gen partners to remove ambiguity and focus on what matters most. Use structured experimentation and measurement to compare approaches, validate results, and improve model performance over time. Improve every day by simplifying workflows, documenting patterns, and applying clear, candid problem-solving when issues arise. Win as one team by sharing insights early, aligning with stakeholders, and collaborating across data, engineering, and business functions. Build solutions with Palantir Foundry and related analytics workflows in a way that supports secure, scalable delivery and long-term reuse. What are we looking for? University degree or equivalent combination of education and experience. 8 years of suggested minimum experience in AI, data science, analytics engineering, or a related field. Strong experience working on complex projects involving data modeling, data mining, pattern analysis, and data visualization. Hands-on experience applying machine learning or other artificial intelligence techniques to business problems. Experience with Palantir Foundry and using enterprise data platforms to support analysis and solution delivery. Ability to translate business requirements into technical approaches and communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Experience working with large datasets, data quality considerations, and iterative solution development. Strong collaboration, organization, and problem-solving skills. Nice to have Experience supporting Finance, commercial analytics, or Lead Gen use cases. Experience implementing AI solutions into products and service offerings. Exposure to production analytics workflows, model evaluation, or solution lifecycle improvement. Experience working in fast-moving, cross-functional environments where priorities can evolve. What do we offer? Comprehensive benefits package. Opportunities for professional growth and development. Supportive and inclusive work environment. Commitment to work-life balance and employee well-being. Engagement in meaningful projects that make a difference. Johnson Controls does not request pregnancy or HIV testing as a condition for hiring, continued employment, or promotion , in accordance with its commitment to labor equality and non-discrimination.

Se requiere disponibilidad para realizar viajes ocasionales. Diseñar y ejecutar análisis que permitan optimizar la asignación de recursos y esfuerzos de cobranza. Elaborar reportes ejecutivos, dashboards y presentaciones para la alta dirección. Realizar seguimiento de KPI's operativos y financieros asociados a la recuperación de cartera. Identificar desviaciones en los resultados y proponer planes de acción correctivos. Participar en pruebas piloto y medición de nuevas estrategias, canales y modelos de contacto. Apoyar la automatización de procesos y generación de información para la toma de decisiones. Indicadores de gestión de cobranza (Roll Rate, Cure Rate, Contact Rate, Promise to Pay, Recovery Rate, entre otros). Segmentación de cartera y comportamiento de clientes. Excel avanzado. SQL intermedio o avanzado. Power BI, Tableau o herramientas de visualización de datos. Estadística aplicada al análisis de negocios. Construcción de dashboards y reportes ejecutivos. Modelos de análisis de datos y medición de desempeño. Conocimientos de automatización y herramientas de análisis (deseable Python o R, GCP, Power BI, Looker). Ofrecemos salario competitivo y beneficios superiores. ¡Gracias por tu postulación!

Title: AI-Native Engineer, New Grad (Hybrid)
Description: Ready to accelerate your career? Clara is the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We've built the leading solution for companies to make and manage all their payments. We already help over 20,000 large and growing businesses operate with agility and financial clarity through locally issued corporate cards, bill pay, financing, and a powerful B2B platform built for scale. Clara is backed by some of the most successful investors in the world, including top regional VCs like monashees, Kaszek, and Canary, and leading global funds like Notable Capital, Coatue, DST Global Partners, ICONIQ Growth, General Catalyst, Citi Ventures, SV Angel, Citius, Endeavor Catalyst, and Goldman Sachs - in addition to dozens of angel investors and local family offices. We're building the financial infrastructure that powers high-performing organizations across the region. We invite you to join us if you want to be part of a fast-paced environment that will accelerate your career and support you to do some of the best work of your life alongside a passionate and committed team distributed across the Americas. Ready to start your career at full speed? What you'll actually do Ship production code in your first weeks — real features, real customers, real money moving. Own features end to end: design, build, test, deploy, watch the metrics, fix what you broke. Use AI across your workflow — coding, debugging, testing, research, automating the boring parts — and push the frontier of how your team uses it, not just how you do. Work directly with Product, Design, and senior engineers. Ask the dumb question early; it's cheaper than the wrong build. Learn the domain deeply. B2B fintech in LatAm is genuinely hard — multiple countries, multiple regulators, real consequences. That's what makes it interesting. Relocation to CDMX is encouraged and supported Two tracks — tell us which one fits you Product Engineering (fullstack, backend-leaning) Backend services, APIs, and the interfaces on top of them. Our stack leans Java/Spring Boot, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, and AWS — but we don't expect you to have used all of it. We expect you to have gone deep on something and to pick up the rest fast. Data & ML Engineering Pipelines, models, and the systems that make them useful in production — risk scoring, fraud signals, spend intelligence. Python, SQL, and modern data tooling. Applied and in production, not just notebooks. Who you are You're at the start of your software career. Whether you finished your degree last month or took a different route to get here, this role is scoped for engineers without prior full-time software experience — and we'll treat you accordingly. A technical foundation. CS, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics or similar — or equivalent ability you can demonstrate in code. You've built things, and you can point at them. A GitHub, a deployed app, a repo people actually use, a hackathon win, a contribution to open source, a bot that solved a real problem for real users. One thing you built and can defend in depth beats a list of ten you touched. You're AI-native and you can prove it. Not "I've used ChatGPT." We mean: you've built with AI — agents, RAG, evals, fine-tunes, a tool that automates something you were sick of doing — and you use AI tools every day in how you code. Come ready to show us the artifact and walk us through the decisions. Strong fundamentals. Data structures, algorithms, systems thinking. Competitive programming (ICPC, OMI, Codeforces), a strong thesis, or serious research all count and we want to hear about them. English proficiency. English is our corporate language — you'll read, write, and discuss technical work in it daily. Ownership. You surface problems before they become blockers, you push things over the finish line, and you don't wait to be told what to do. This is the single trait we screen hardest for. Nice to haves Basic proficiency in Portuguese or a desire to learn it. Why join Clara At Clara, you'll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America. Who we are We're the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America. Certified as one of the world's fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work, and a LinkedIn Top Startup. Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive. Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive. Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar. Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment. What we believe in #Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively. #Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters. #Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told. #Pride. We build products and experiences we're proud of. #Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action. #Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission. What we offer Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language) Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results If you're ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America. Clara's Hybrid Policy Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team. We don't enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you're expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp-up or when required by your leader.

Title: Coordinador Inteligencia Artificial y Automatizaciones
Description: Ser parte del Tecnológico de Monterrey significa que tendrás la oportunidad de colaborar en una comunidad centrada en la educación, la innovación, la investigación y excelencia para transformar positivamente nuestro entorno. Aquí puedes potenciar tu talento y desarrollarte con un propósito trascendental: imaginar, emprender y construir soluciones que impactan positivamente a las personas y a la comunidad. ¡Esta oportunidad es para ti! Únete al Tec y transforma el futuro junto a nosotros. ¿Qué harás? Siendo Coordinador de Inteligencia Artificial y Automatizaciones el reto principal es Traducir necesidades del área de Acompañamiento en soluciones funcionales de inteligencia artificial y automatización. Diseña prototipos, organiza y protege la información que los alimenta, y desarrolla aplicaciones y flujos que mejoren la operación y la experiencia de los usuarios. Mide resultados, documenta las soluciones y coordina su adopción con los equipos involucrados. ¿Cómo lo harás? Tus principales retos serán: Levantar necesidades con los usuarios, definir el problema, los requisitos funcionales y los criterios para validar cada solución. Traducir una indicación funcional en un prototipo de IA utilizable: seleccionar fuentes, configurar instrucciones y herramientas, construir el flujo de interacción y probarlo con casos reales antes de iterar. Estructurar y optimizar bases de conocimiento para soluciones de IA: depurar contenidos, organizar fuentes y metadatos, mantener versiones y evaluar la pertinencia y calidad de las respuestas. Proteger las bases de conocimiento y los datos utilizados por los prototipos mediante permisos de acceso, clasificación de información, manejo de datos sensibles y pruebas para detectar respuestas o accesos indebidos, en coordinación con TI y las políticas institucionales. Diseñar, construir y mantener flujos en Power Automate y aplicaciones en Power Apps, incluyendo formularios, aprobaciones, notificaciones e integración con las fuentes de datos autorizadas. Procesar y estructurar datos para la operación y la toma de decisiones; identificar oportunidades de mejora y medir el efecto de las soluciones implementadas. Documentar configuración, fuentes, permisos, pruebas y funcionamiento de las soluciones; capacitar a los equipos y acompañar su adopción ¿Qué buscamos? Si tienes formación en Licenciatura en Ingeniería, Tecnologías de la Información, Ciencia de Datos, Transformación Digital o áreas afines. Has tenido la experiencia de trabajar en práctica en prototipos con IA generativa y gestión de bases de conocimiento: curación de fuentes, configuración, evaluación de respuestas y controles básicos de acceso y confidencialidad. Capacidad para definir requerimientos, mapear journeys y colaborar con equipos técnicos y usuarios de negocio. Conocimiento de herramientas de diseño y metodologías ágiles y entre tus habilidades se encuentran Manejo práctico de Power Automate y Power Apps para construir y dar mantenimiento a soluciones de principio a fin; familiaridad con Microsoft 365 y fuentes de datos como SharePoint Lists. Conocimientos de análisis y limpieza de datos; Python, R o herramientas de visualización como Looker son útiles según el proyecto. ¡Te estamos buscando, postúlate ya! Contacto: Emmanuel Cruz Correo: mecruz@tec.mx ¡Impulsa al máximo tu desarrollo profesional! Description: CARRERAS PARA SONREÍR En PepsiCo, descubrirás un lugar donde nuestra misión es crear sonrisas alrededor del mundo. Con más de 500 marcas queridas, incluyen Gatorade, Lay's y Quaker y nuestro trabajo llega a millones de personas cada día. En el corazón de nuestra compañía hay un equipo de pensadores y creadores que colaboran para innovar y convertir las ideas en acciones. Impulsados por la innovación y centrados en crear momentos de alegría a través de los alimentos y bebidas, nuestras decisiones se guían por y para el consumidor, creando oportunidades para que nuestros asociados realicen un trabajo significativo y tengan un impacto duradero en las comunidades a las que servimos. Sea cual sea tu función, formarás parte de una comunidad global que valora tus ideas y te empodera para que tengas impacto en tu carrera y en el mundo que te rodea. Su función combina habilidades analíticas con atención al cliente interno brindando soporte operativo al área de ventas mediante reportes, seguimiento de indicadores y gestión básica de documentación utilizando herramientas del paquete Office. Tu impacto Como People Operations Asst Analyst tus funciones constarían de… Recopilar, depurar y analizar datos provenientes de diversas fuentes para generar reportes comerciales y operativos. Elaborar dashboards e indicadores clave de desempeño (KPIs) que faciliten el monitoreo de resultados del área de ventas. Brindar soporte directo al equipo comercial en requerimientos de información, cotizaciones, seguimiento a clientes (alta, bajas y Modificaciones) Mantener actualizadas bases de datos de clientes, productos, ventas y oportunidades. Preparar informes periódicos en Excel, PowerPoint y Word para presentaciones internas. Detectar tendencias, variaciones y oportunidades de mejora en el comportamiento de ventas. Dar seguimiento a solicitudes de clientes y coordinar la comunicación con áreas involucradas. Apoyar en la automatización o simplificación de procesos mediante herramientas básicas del paquete Office. Conocimientos y Habilidades Análisis de datos: manejo de bases de datos, interpretación de información, análisis estadístico básico, elaboración de reportes. Ventas y servicio al cliente: comunicación efectiva, seguimiento de clientes, comprensión del ciclo comercial. Paquete Office (nivel básico–intermedio): Excel: tablas, filtros, gráficos, fórmulas básicas. PowerPoint: elaboración de presentaciones ejecutivas. Word: redacción y formateo de documentos. Pensamiento crítico orientado a resultados. Organización, atención al detalle y control documental. Capacidad para trabajar bajo objetivos y múltiples solicitudes simultáneas. ¿A quién buscamos? Licenciatura concluida en Administración, Ingeniería, Sistemas, Informática o carrera afín. Experiencia en análisis de datos, administración de bases de datos o control administrativo. Manejo de paquetería Microsoft Office. Manejo de Excel (tablas dinámicas, fórmulas, cruces de información y análisis de datos). Deseable conocimiento en Power BI o herramientas de análisis de datos. Habilidad analítica, organización, atención al detalle, orientación al servicio y trabajo en equipo. Qué puedes esperar de nosotros: Oportunidades para aprender y desarrollarte todos los días a través de una amplia oferta de programas. Plataformas internas digitales que promueven el self-learning.
